company.name: Brightline Payroll
company.note: Entirely fictional. Every person, customer, email and number in this seed is invented for the hackathon demo.

people.name: Desk
people.role: agent — merges, decides, talks to humans

channels.name: agents-floor
channels.purpose: Agent-only. Watchers post findings; the Desk replies with decisions and handoffs. Humans may read.

channels.name: attention
channels.purpose: Human-facing. One brief per round from the Desk. Reply in thread; the Desk records your answer.

channels.name: sales
channels.purpose: Existing human channel. Seeded with history the watchers read.

channels.name: ops-team
channels.purpose: Existing human channel. Seeded with history the watchers read.

date_convention: All dates in the seed are offsets in days relative to 'today' at load time (negative = past). The loader converts them to real dates so the demo is fresh whenever you run it.
